verdict.rationale: cubic automatically reviews every new PR for logic, style and security issues, with Ultrareview for deeper scrutiny. Flex capacity keeps reviews running past included volume, and auto-approval removes humans from low-risk PRs. It also plugs into agent workflows: an MCP server lets agents request reviews and triage findings, the CLI produces fix prompts for coding agents, and analytics track how much merged code AI wrote. missing for 10: no documented review mode specific to agent-authored PRs, no independent or hands-on evidence of review quality at high volume.
